mapping.draft_py:
# Elspeth's Smite: "Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
# If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead."
# The compiler gave no tree. Sentence 1 is Scorching Dragonfire's DEAL_DAMAGE with the target filter
# "attacking or blocking creature": TYPE_EQ Creature and FOr(IS_ATTACKING, IS_BLOCKING) (the
# compiler's own IS_ATTACKING conjunct, templates_b5a). Sentence 2 is Scorching Dragonfire's
# verified card-level ReplacementAbility (B5b-repl-die-exile, B-77), byte for byte, placed before
# the SpellAbility as in that card and in M20 Reduce to Ashes.
repl = ReplacementAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET)),
    condition=None,
    action=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            referent='event',
        ),
    }),
)
spell = SpellAbility(
    kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
    effect=A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=3),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FOr(children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ATTACKING),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_BLOCKING),
                )),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [repl, spell]

clauses.clause: Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.

mapping.notes: The compiler gave no tree. Sentence 1: Scorching Dragonfire's DEAL_DAMAGE with the target 'attacking or blocking creature' = TYPE_EQ Creature and FOr(IS_ATTACKING, IS_BLOCKING). Sentence 2: Scorching Dragonfire's verified card-level ReplacementAbility byte for byte (B-77; M20 Reduce to Ashes). The probe board has no combat, so G1 casts nothing. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/elspeths_smite_*.json (a blocker it kills is exiled; an attacker that survives and dies later this turn is exiled, an untargeted creature dying beside it is not; no target out of combat).

clauses.clause: Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature.
clauses.evidence: The probe's only line is 'cast skipped: a target slot needs 1, the board offers 0': nothing on the standard board attacks or blocks, so no variant shows the damage or the menu. Covered by packs: A01_2 (exactly 3 damage marked on a 4/4 attacker, which survives), A01_1 (a 3/3 attacker is killed, a second attacker that was not targeted is unharmed), A01_5 (a blocking creature is a legal target and takes 3), A01_6 (in the main phase neither side's creature is a legal target: refused).

clauses.clause: If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
clauses.evidence: Not reached by the probe (cast skipped, see above). Covered by packs: A01_1 (the 3/3 attacker dies to the 3 damage and is exiled, never in the graveyard), A01_5 (the same for a blocker), A01_3 (a 4/4 survives the spell, then 1 more damage the same turn exiles it, while an untargeted creature dying that turn goes to the graveyard), A01_4 (on the next turn it dies to the graveyard).
